Class Stats

java.lang.Object
Stats
public class Stats extends Object
Population counters, peak tracking, and end-of-run line graphs for the simulation.

Each simulated year this class recounts predators and prey, records history series, and can signal that the run should end when either population hits zero. draw(Graphics2D) plots prey (green), predators (red), deaths by old age (blue), and kills by predators (black).

    • updateLogic

      public boolean updateLogic(List<Organism> worldEntities)
      On year boundaries, recounts living predators and prey and records peaks.

      Returns true when either population is zero so the simulation can stop. Between year boundaries this method is a no-op and returns false.

      Parameters:
      worldEntities - all currently living organisms
      Returns:
      true if a population has gone extinct and the run should end

    • drawLineGraph

      private void drawLineGraph(Graphics2D g2d, List<Integer> history, int maxPop, double xSpacing)
      Connects consecutive history samples as a polyline scaled to maxPop.
      Parameters:
      g2d - graphics context to draw into
      history - yearly samples to plot; ignored if fewer than two points
      maxPop - value that maps to the top of the graph
      xSpacing - horizontal pixels between consecutive samples
